samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>An asynchronous FIFO with configurable depth and width.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="WIDTH">8</parameter>
        <parameter name="DEPTH">16</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="waddr_bin" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Write address register.</reg>
        <reg id="raddr_bin" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Read address register.</reg>
        <reg id="wptr" width_description="4">Write pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="rptr" width_description="4">Read pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="wptr_syn" width_description="4">Synchronized write pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="rptr_syn" width_description="4">Synchronized read pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="wptr_buff" width_description="4">Buffered write pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="rptr_buff" width_description="4">Buffered read pointer.</reg>
        <wire id="wen" width_description="1">Write enable.</wire>
        <wire id="ren" width_description="1">Read enable.</wire>
        <wire id="gray_wptr" width_description="4">Gray code write pointer.</wire>
        <wire id="gray_rptr" width_description="4">Gray code read pointer.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Dual-port RAM instantiation
        <instance id="dual_port_RAM">
            <port id="wclk" value="wclk"/>
            <port id="renc" value="ren"/>
            <port id="rclk" value="rclk"/>
            <port id="wenc" value="wen"/>
            <port id="waddr" value="waddr_bin"/>
            <port id="raddr" value="raddr_bin"/>
            <port id="wdata" value="wdata"/>
            <port id="rdata" value="rdata"/>
        </instance>

        // Write pointer logic
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr_bin <= 0;
            end else if (winc) begin
                waddr_bin <= (waddr_bin + 1) % DEPTH;
            end
        end

        // Read pointer logic
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr_bin <= 0;
            end else if (rinc) begin
                raddr_bin <= (raddr_bin + 1) % DEPTH;
            end
        end

        // Gray code conversion
        assign gray_wptr[0] = wptr[0];
        assign gray_wptr[1] = wptr[0] ^ wptr[1];
        assign gray_wptr[2] = wptr[1] ^ wptr[2];
        assign gray_wptr[3] = wptr[2] ^ wptr[3];

        assign gray_rptr[0] = rptr[0];
        assign gray_rptr[1] = rptr[0] ^ rptr[1];
        assign gray_rptr[2] = rptr[1] ^ rptr[2];
        assign gray_rptr[3] = rptr[2] ^ rptr[3];

        // Pointer synchronization
        always @(posedge wclk) begin
            wptr_syn <= gray_wptr;
        end

        always @(posedge rclk) begin
            rptr_syn <= gray_rptr;
        end

        // Buffering pointers
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr_syn;
            end
        end

        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr_syn;
            end
        end

        // Full and empty signals
        assign wfull = (wptr_syn == {~rptr_syn[3], rptr_syn[2:0]});
        assign rempty = (wptr_syn == rptr_syn);

        // Enable signals
        assign wen = ~wfull & winc;
        assign ren = ~rempty & rinc;

        // Connect outputs
        rdata <= dual_port_RAM.rdata;
    </implementation>
</module>
